answer.value: Follows the "ViT–MLP–LLM" paradigm; language model initialized from the Qwen3 series and GPT-OSS, vision encoder from InternViT-300M and InternViT-6B; retains the Dynamic High Resolution strategy from InternVL1.5. For this 20B-A4B model: 0.3B vision params, 20.9B language params, 21.2B-A4B total. Each image patch is 1024 visual tokens from the vision encoder, compressed into 256 tokens via pixel shuffle before the LLM.
quotes: This series of models follow the "ViT–MLP–LLM" paradigm adopted in previous versions of InternVL.
We initialize the language model using the Qwen3 series and GPT-OSS, and the vision encoder using InternViT-300M and InternViT-6B.
The Dynamic High Resolution strategy introduced in InternVL1.5 is also retained in our design.

Specifically, in InternVL3.5, each image patch is initially represented as 1024 visual tokens for the vision encoder, which are then compressed into 256 tokens via a pixel shuffle module before being passed to the Large Language Model (LLM).
